events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict is expected to escalate, affecting global markets. The US and Iran are engaged in a war that involves military, economy, and geopolitics.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core S&P Total U.S. Stock Market ETF (ITOT)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased volatility in global markets, causing a flight to safe-haven assets like gold. The US stock market is expected to decline due to the uncertainty and geopolitical risks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close the position when the conflict de-escalates or when the gold price reaches $1800

events.title: Fed Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to hike interest rates due to the surge in inflation. The next Fed meeting will be crucial in determining the direction of the US economy.
events.reasoning: The expected interest rate hike will lead to a decline in the US stock market and an increase in bond yields. The long-term Treasury bond ETF is expected to perform well in this scenario.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the Fed's decision and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close the position when the Fed announces a rate hike or when the bond yield reaches 4.5%

gains.conservativeNote: If the rate hike is modest
gains.extendedNote: If the rate hike is aggressive
